newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador to grow 3-4 pct in '96 - central bank.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador to grow 3-4 pct in '96 - central bank.

text.p: El Salvador's central bank governor Roberto Orellana said Tuesday that economic growth in 1996 would be between three and four percent, down from five percent last year.
Inflation would also fall, though, to an expected eight to nine percent from 11.4 percent last year, Orellana told a news conference.
The economy has been sluggish so far this year, but "we are expecting growth levels to improve towards the end of the year, so we are estimating growth at between three and four percent," he said.
International reserves at the end of September stood at $1.062 billion, up by $127 million compared to a year earlier, he added.
The trade deficit narrowed to $1.057 billion in the same period from $1.237 billion at the end of September 1995.
